get.description: Current Project Owner with current Session, in one transaction under User SH then Project SH. Maximum 3-second budget begins before authentication; actual synchronous cleanup may continue after expiry but no late publication. GET and HEAD have identical work/status/headers; HEAD has no body. No request body, CSRF, command key, scope or principal override. Closed single-valued query, at most 32768 RawQuery bytes. 1 MiB pre-encoded success limit; no truncation.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Canonical decimal 1–200; empty, leading zero, sign, exponent and overflow are invalid.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Signed Project scope, complete canonical filter and fixed descending order; limit and current subject are not bound. Every page reauthorizes.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional [from,to) bound; canonical filter normalizes legal offsets/fractions to UTC. Both present require from < to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional [from,to) bound; canonical filter normalizes legal offsets/fractions to UTC. Both present require from < to.
